metadata.title: Misuse and Abuse Detection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for detecting harmful, unauthorized, or policy-violating uses of AI systems, including dual-use and emergent misuse.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI behavioral monitoring, misuse detection systems, anomaly detection, and policy enforcement mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how AI usage is monitored, analyzed, and constrained to detect and stop misuse or abuse.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat context for dual-use misuse, intentional abuse, and harmful repurposing of AI systems.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where AI systems are repurposed or used in ways that violate policy, ethics, or intended use.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats arising from patterns of use that become harmful over time or through aggregation rather than single actions.

metadata.remarks: Misuse and Abuse Detection defines how AI systems are monitored to identify harmful, unauthorized, or policy-violating use. This pattern exists to address AI-native risks where harm arises from misuse, dual-use, or emergent behavior rather than direct technical compromise.

components.title: Usage Monitoring and Anomaly Detection
components.description: Continuous monitoring of AI usage patterns to detect abnormal, risky, or emerging misuse behaviors.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI system usage is continuously monitored to identify anomalous, excessive, or suspicious behavior patterns.

components.title: Policy Violation Detection
components.description: Detection of AI usage that violates declared intended use, governance rules, or ethical constraints.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI outputs and behaviors are evaluated against declared intended use and policy constraints to detect violations.

components.title: Response and Containment
components.description: Actions taken to limit or stop AI misuse once detected, including throttling, suspension, or escalation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Detected AI misuse triggers containment actions such as access restriction, capability de-scoping, or incident escalation.
